column49: Trajectoire globale de contrainte CO₂ au niveau du réseau (hors aviation internationale & UTCATF) | F5 decision (2026-09-05): `budget_national` follows the system `co2_budget` series, so these anchors are the adopted model trajectory, not the 2026-07-26 literature reading. The literature anchors were 64.8 @2030 / 45.0 @2040 / 5.0 @2050 - the same shape one decade later. Before the decision the global cap was always the tighter of the two and every national cap was inert after 2025 (duals ~1e-8; in 2040 the national caps summed to 176 % of the global cap), so the agreed Walloon target was never enforced. Anchors now sit on every planning horizon, so year_rule=interp has nothing to interpolate; add an anchor if a run introduces 2035/2045. Values are % of 1990; config expects a fraction (divide by 100).
